rubric.role_summary: Software engineer optimizing large AI model inference for high-volume, low-latency production and research environments, including distributed-system performance, reliability, and GPU utilization.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Software engineer optimizing large AI model inference for high-volume, low-latency production and research environments, including distributed-system performance, reliability, and GPU utilization.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
- Understanding of modern ML architectures and how to optimize their performance, particularly for inference.
- Experience architecting, building, observing, and debugging production distributed systems.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with performance-critical distributed systems.
- Experience rebuilding or substantially refactoring production systems several times because of rapidly increasing scale.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
